column1: # The .env schema: every setting mediastack or its compose files read.
# lib/env.sh validates .env against it (values on every command, unknown keys
# in doctor); CI holds the code and .env.example to it (scripts/test-env.sh).
#   key     a name, or a family: <svc>_X for every service (its name
#           uppercased, - as _), <arr> for the arrs trash-sync manages,
#           <root> for CONFIG_ROOT, DATA_ROOT, CACHE_ROOT, TRANSCODE_ROOT, BACKUP_ROOT
#   type    text secret path dirname int pint pct bool uid port size tz
#           calendar profiles host domain email url cname enum:a|b ...
#           retired:N (no longer used since schema N — doctor says so)
#   empty   ok = an empty value is allowed (usually: not set yet / use the default)
#   writer  you | wizard (configure or a setup verb asks) | script (written for
#           you) | advanced (read with a default; set it only to change that)
#           — you and wizard keys must appear in .env.example
